messages:
Marta: idea: make fallback decisions auditable in responses themselves. include a short response header/field with 'fallback_reason' and a 'latency_budget_token' so SDKs can introspect why we fell back and how much budget remains.

Luca: interesting. that helps caller-level adaption (e.g., shorten downstream timeouts). what would the token look like? opaque or structured?

Marta: opaque but HMACed + short-lived. fields encoded: manifest_epoch, denied_ops (if any), remaining_budget_ms. server can decode for internal debugging. we avoid leaking internal policy by HMAC.

Sara: must ensure we don't create a new telemetry channel. token decode should be optional for customers with strict isolation. default: token present only if observability_mode != none.

Evan: runtime implication: when a fallback is denied because of trust_tier, return HTTP 409 with body {code:"ERR_FALLBACK_DENIED", manifest_epoch:"...", denied_op:"kv_share"} and header X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason: "trust_tier:hardware_isolated". SDK maps that to a typed exception.

Marta: plus a small 'capability_lease' TTL on manifests: adapters declare manifest_ttl seconds so controlplane knows how stale capability info can be before probing. if ttl expires, controlplane falls back to conservative defaults (deny kv_share etc.)

Luca: add 'op_grace_window' per op so if manifest changes during a rolling upgrade we allow in-flight ops to finish for N seconds. avoids mid-request denials.

Sara: testability: add a 'dry_switch' flag per tenant so controlplane simulates switch and emits a synthetic response header (X-Redwood-Fallback-Dry: true) without performing the traffic change. useful for perf and billing estimates.

Evan: ops: we also need a small audit cache on controlplane for the last 10k fallback events per region to reconstruct cascades. UI shows chain: origin -> chosen_target -> fallback_reason. If observability_mode==none, mark chain as partial.

Marta: security: token HMAC key must be per-tenant or per-region KMS key to avoid cross-tenant inference. document key rotation behavior: signatures valid for token_lifetime (10s) and manifest_lease independent.

Luca: UX: SDK surface should be tiny: FallbackError {code, reason, deniedOp, remainingBudgetMs}. Don't force apps to parse headers.

Sara: backwards compatibility: controlplane should backfill response header only when fallback occurs. Hosts that don't understand header just ignore.

Evan: TL;DR: add response-level fallback metadata + capability_lease + op_grace_window + dry_switch. enforce deny for hardware_isolated, map to typed SDK errors, keep telemetry optional. I'll draft RFC section for response metadata and token format.
